name.description: The icon set name. Camel case names are converted to kebab case.

icons.description: List of icon names. Leave out this property to include every icon in the icon set.

location.description: The location of the icon set in Iconify JSON format. Can be any HTTP location, module name, or local path.

prefix.description: Prefix configuration for the Tailwind CSS utility classes.

mask.description: The prefix for the mask-image icon utility.

background.description: The prefix for the background-image icon utility.
